title: Review secrets move to OSF_REVIEW_* names
summary: Renames the review pipeline's credentials from bare names (VERIFIER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, VERIFIER_APP_ID) to repository-level OSF_REVIEW_* secrets and variables. The reusable review-check workflow's `workflow_call` secret declarations, the three reviewer jobs' env mappings, the verifier token mint, the thin caller's app-id input, the workflow contract tests and the adopter docs all move together; the `review` environment gate on the main branch is unchanged.

nodes.label: review.yml caller
nodes.subtitle: thin caller, runs from base branch
nodes.summary: The adopter's thin workflow that calls the reusable review-check workflow. It now passes the verifier app id from `vars.OSF_REVIEW_VERIFIER_APP_ID` and forwards secrets with `secrets: inherit`.

nodes.label: Repo secrets & vars
nodes.subtitle: OSF_REVIEW_* names
nodes.summary: Repository-level secrets and variables in the repository that holds the calling workflow. Every credential the review pipeline reads now carries the `OSF_REVIEW_` prefix, so the names are namespaced to this tool rather than generic.

nodes.label: review-check.yml
nodes.subtitle: workflow_call contract
nodes.summary: The reusable workflow. Its `workflow_call` secret declarations are renamed to the `OSF_REVIEW_*` names, and each job's env mapping reads the renamed secret. The `review` environment on the jobs, and its main-branch limit, are untouched.

nodes.label: codex reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: CODEX_API_KEY from OSF_REVIEW_OPENAI_API_KEY
nodes.summary: Runs the codex reviewer in the review container. It still signs in via `CODEX_API_KEY`, now sourced from `secrets.OSF_REVIEW_OPENAI_API_KEY`.

nodes.label: claude reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
nodes.summary: Runs the claude reviewer. Its env now reads `secrets.OSF_REVIEW_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`; the variable name inside the container is unchanged.

nodes.label: opencode reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
nodes.summary: Runs the opencode reviewer. Its env now reads `secrets.OSF_REVIEW_OPENROUTER_API_KEY`; the container-side variable name is unchanged.

nodes.label: verifier / post job
nodes.subtitle: last job, mints app token
nodes.summary: The final job that collects answers, decides and posts. It alone mints the verifier app's token, now with `private-key: secrets.OSF_REVIEW_VERIFIER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`; the test still asserts exactly one read of that secret.

nodes.label: review container
nodes.subtitle: docker run, tree mounted read-only
nodes.summary: The sandbox each reviewer runs in, with the pull request's tree mounted read-only as data. Unchanged by this diff; it receives whichever provider key its job maps in.

nodes.label: GitHub secrets store
nodes.subtitle: repository-level OSF_REVIEW_*
nodes.summary: Where the renamed repository-level secrets live. The `review` environment still gates the jobs that read them to the main branch.

nodes.label: create-github-app-token
nodes.subtitle: verifier app installation token
nodes.summary: The action that exchanges the verifier app id and private key for an installation token with pull-request write and contents read. Unchanged; only the secret name feeding it moved.

nodes.label: review_workflow.rs
nodes.subtitle: contract assertions on the YAML
nodes.summary: Integration tests that pin the workflow's shape: which provider secret each reviewer job reads, that only the verifier key is required, that only the last job reads it, and that the caller passes the app id. All assertions follow the renamed identifiers.

nodes.label: osf.toml reviewers
nodes.subtitle: claude, opencode enabled
nodes.summary: The factory config naming the reviewer agents in order. Its comment now points at the `OSF_REVIEW_*` variable names the review job reads; the reviewer list itself is unchanged.

edges.label: secrets: inherit
edges.summary: The caller forwards the renamed secrets to the reusable workflow. Because the names changed, an adopter that mapped secrets by name must update the mapping or switch to `secrets: inherit`.

edges.label: vars.OSF_REVIEW_VERIFIER_APP_ID
edges.summary: The verifier app id now comes from the prefixed repository variable.

edges.label: workflow_call OSF_REVIEW_*
edges.summary: The `workflow_call` block declares the four renamed secrets, with only the verifier key required. This declaration is the contract the caller must satisfy.

edges.label: OSF_REVIEW_OPENAI_API_KEY
edges.summary: The codex job maps the renamed OpenAI key into `CODEX_API_KEY`.

edges.label: OSF_REVIEW_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
edges.summary: The claude job maps the renamed OAuth token into the container env.

edges.label: OSF_REVIEW_OPENROUTER_API_KEY
edges.summary: The opencode job maps the renamed OpenRouter key into the container env.

edges.label: OSF_REVIEW_VERIFIER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
edges.summary: Only the last job reads the verifier private key, now under its prefixed name.
The codex job launches the review container with the tree mounted read-only.
The claude job launches the review container with the tree mounted read-only.
The opencode job launches the review container with the tree mounted read-only.
The last job exchanges the app id and private key for an installation token.

edges.label: private-key
edges.summary: The token action consumes the renamed verifier private key.
The tests parse the workflow YAML and assert the renamed secret names, required flags and single-read property.
A test asserts the caller passes `vars.OSF_REVIEW_VERIFIER_APP_ID`.

edges.label: comment only
edges.summary: The config's comment now names the `OSF_REVIEW_*` variables the review job reads; the reviewer list is unchanged.

flows.title: A reviewer job resolves its renamed secret
flows.summary: How one reviewer job gets its provider credential after the rename: the caller forwards secrets, the reusable workflow declares them under OSF_REVIEW_* names, and the job maps the right one into the container env.

views.title: Review pipeline containers
views.summary: The caller, the reusable workflow's jobs, the reviewer containers and the GitHub-side secrets and token action.

views.title: Secret resolution sequence
views.summary: One reviewer job's path from the caller's forwarded secrets to the container env after the rename.
